BELGRAVE CROSS COUNTRY CHAMPIONSHIPS 1987.
Frank Ward(8) Winner of 10 Miles Senior, Martin Lake Runner Up in both 7½ and 10 Miles Senior races and Richard Blick (2) Winner of Youths race and Matthew Egerickx(7) Winner of the Boys Championship.
Of the younger generation, Freddie Ocrah sprinted to some fast times for a 'Boy', equalling the club record over 200m, while Richard Blick showed middle distance promise.

In the younger age groups, there were good performances from Richard Blick (800/1500) Joe Minetti (100) and Freddie Ocrah (100/200 Boys). The highlight of the day was the re-enactment of an 100 yards race from the turn of the Century.
